language_origin.basis: New English synthesis of hash-verified original historical summaries; not a reviewed translation.

trigger: Position/tool-axis control is close to a joint threshold; position alone may pass.
procedure: Evaluate every original position and directed tool-axis predicate on the complete frozen scoring grid. A passing position alone does not establish task acceptance.

Read unrounded residuals, units, solver status and independent evaluation before interpreting a near-threshold failure. Finite search failure does not prove structural infeasibility or evaluator error.

BF5 records a failed precheck followed by a separately authorized finite continuation and an independent pass. This supports investigating residuals under the original thresholds; it does not guarantee that another task or continuation will pass.

Counterexample: BF6 R7 still failed the original position bound despite a passing tool-axis predicate and improved native values. Preserve the recorded STOP; a small positive residual is still a failure.

Check model, task, timing, structure, initialization and budget applicability before transfer. Directed tool axis does not cover full orientation or axial roll. Historical controls and parameter values are not a current-task prescription.

bindings.physics: Frozen historical MuJoCo/GVS model and task; check exact applicability before transfer

applicability: Conjunctive sampled position/directed-axis tasks, including oriented tracking.
Directed tool axis is two orientation degrees of freedom; this does not cover full pose or axial roll.
escalation: Guidance only. Obtain current scoped evidence and authorization before any scientific action; preserve original STOP and budgets.
